description: This file contains implementation of range set manipulation, diff processing, and line log data management functions used for blame or history tracking features within a version control system, likely Git.

methods.name: void range_set_init(struct range_set * rs,size_t prealloc)
methods.description: Initializes a range set, optionally preallocating space.

methods.name: void range_set_release(struct range_set * rs)
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a range set.

methods.name: void range_set_copy(struct range_set * dst,struct range_set * src)
methods.description: Copies one range set to another.

methods.name: void range_set_move(struct range_set * dst,struct range_set * src)
methods.description: Moves the contents of one range set to another, invalidating the source.

methods.name: void range_set_append_unsafe(struct range_set * rs,long a,long b)
methods.description: Appends a new range unsafely without merging or ordering checks.

methods.name: void range_set_append(struct range_set * rs,long a,long b)
methods.description: Appends a range ensuring sorted order with previous ranges.

methods.name: int range_cmp(const void * _r,const void * _s)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting ranges.

methods.name: void range_set_check_invariants(struct range_set * rs)
methods.description: Checks sorting and non-overlapping invariants of ranges.

methods.name: void sort_and_merge_range_set(struct range_set * rs)
methods.description: Sorts and merges overlapping or adjacent ranges in place.

methods.name: void range_set_union(struct range_set * out,struct range_set * a,struct range_set * b)
methods.description: Calculates the union of two range sets into an output set.

methods.name: void range_set_difference(struct range_set * out,struct range_set * a,struct range_set * b)
methods.description: Computes the difference of two range sets (a  ).

methods.name: void diff_ranges_init(struct diff_ranges * diff)
methods.description: Initializes diff_ranges with empty range sets.

methods.name: void diff_ranges_release(struct diff_ranges * diff)
methods.description: Releases resources used by diff_ranges.

methods.name: void line_log_data_init(struct line_log_data * r)
methods.description: Initializes line_log_data including range set.

methods.name: void line_log_data_clear(struct line_log_data * r)
methods.description: Clears and frees resources of line_log_data.

methods.name: void free_line_log_data(struct line_log_data * r)
methods.description: Frees a linked list of line_log_data objects.

methods.name: struct:line_log_data * search_line_log_data(struct line_log_data * list,const char * path,struct line_log_data ** insertion_point)
methods.description: Searches for a path in a list of line_log_data.

methods.name: void line_log_data_insert(struct line_log_data ** list,char * path,long begin,long end)
methods.description: Inserts a new line range entry into the list.

methods.name: int collect_diff_cb(long start_a,long count_a,long start_b,long count_b,void * data)
methods.description: Callback for collecting diff ranges.

methods.name: int collect_diff(mmfile_t * parent,mmfile_t * target,struct diff_ranges * out)
methods.description: Computes diff between parent and target files.

methods.name: dump_range_set
methods.description: Debug function to dump range set contents.

methods.name: dump_line_log_data
methods.description: Debug function to dump line_log_data list.

methods.name: dump_diff_ranges
methods.description: Debug function to dump diff ranges.

methods.name: int ranges_overlap(struct range * a,struct range * b)
methods.description: Checks if two ranges overlap.

methods.name: void diff_ranges_filter_touched(struct diff_ranges * out,struct diff_ranges * diff,struct range_set * rs)
methods.description: Filters diff ranges to those touching specified range set.

methods.name: void range_set_shift_diff(struct range_set * out,struct range_set * rs,struct diff_ranges * diff)
methods.description: Adjusts line counts based on diff hunks.

methods.name: void range_set_map_across_diff(struct range_set * out,struct range_set * rs,struct diff_ranges * diff,struct diff_ranges ** touched_out)
methods.description: Maps ranges across a diff, adjusting blame ranges.

methods.name: struct:commit * check_single_commit(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Ensures only a single valid commit is in revs.

methods.name: void fill_blob_sha1(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit,struct diff_filespec * spec)
methods.description: Fills in the SHA1 hex and mode for a file spec from a commit.

methods.name: void fill_line_ends(struct repository * r,struct diff_filespec * spec,long * lines,unsigned long ** line_ends)
methods.description: Computes line end positions in a blob specification.

methods.name: const char * nth_line(void * data,long line)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific line from data using line ends array.

methods.name: struct:line_log_data * parse_lines(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit,const char * prefix,struct string_list * args)
methods.description: Parses line ranges from command arguments.

methods.name: struct:line_log_data * line_log_data_copy_one(struct line_log_data * r)
methods.description: Copies a single line_log_data object.

methods.name: struct:line_log_data * line_log_data_copy(struct line_log_data * r)
methods.description: Copies a linked list of line_log_data objects.

methods.name: struct:line_log_data * line_log_data_merge(struct line_log_data * a,struct line_log_data * b)
methods.description: Merges two line_log_data structures.

methods.name: void add_line_range(struct rev_info * revs,struct commit * commit,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Associates a line range with a commit.

methods.name: void clear_commit_line_range(struct rev_info * revs,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Clears line range decorations for a commit.

methods.name: struct:line_log_data * lookup_line_range(struct rev_info * revs,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Retrieves line ranges associated with a commit.

methods.name: int same_paths_in_pathspec_and_range(struct pathspec * pathspec,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Checks if pathspec matches the paths in range.

methods.name: void parse_pathspec_from_ranges(struct pathspec * pathspec,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Parses a pathspec from a list of ranges.

methods.name: void line_log_init(struct rev_info * rev,const char * prefix,struct string_list * args)
methods.description: Initializes line logging for a commit with specified line ranges and pathspecs.

methods.name: void move_diff_queue(struct diff_queue_struct * dst,struct diff_queue_struct * src)
methods.description: Moves a diff queue from source to destination.

methods.name: void filter_diffs_for_paths(struct line_log_data * range,int keep_deletions)
methods.description: Filters diff file pairs to those matching specified paths.

methods.name: void queue_diffs(struct line_log_data * range,struct diff_options * opt,struct diff_queue_struct * queue,struct commit * commit,struct commit * parent)
methods.description: Queues diffs for a commit and its parent.

methods.name: char * get_nth_line(long line,unsigned long * ends,void * data)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific line from data using line ends.

methods.name: void print_line(const char * prefix,char first,long line,unsigned long * ends,void * data,const char * color,const char * reset,FILE * file)
methods.description: Prints a formatted line with prefix, color, and line info.

methods.name: void dump_diff_hacky_one(struct rev_info * rev,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Prints a detailed diff for a line range, with hunk headers.

methods.name: void dump_diff_hacky(struct rev_info * rev,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Iterates over ranges to dump their diffs for blame display.

methods.name: int process_diff_filepair(struct rev_info * rev,struct diff_filepair * pair,struct line_log_data * range,struct diff_ranges ** diff_out)
methods.description: Processes diff for a file pair and maps blame ranges.

methods.name: struct:diff_filepair * diff_filepair_dup(struct diff_filepair * pair)
methods.description: Duplicates a diff filepair, incrementing reference counts.

methods.name: int process_all_files(struct line_log_data ** range_out,struct rev_info * rev,struct diff_queue_struct * queue,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Processes all files in a diff queue for blame ranges.

methods.name: int line_log_print(struct rev_info * rev,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Prints the blame info with diffs for a commit.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_check(struct rev_info * rev,struct commit * commit,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Checks if blame ranges are in bloom filter for commit.

methods.name: int process_ranges_ordinary_commit(struct rev_info * rev,struct commit * commit,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Processes blame ranges for a normal commit.

methods.name: int process_ranges_merge_commit(struct rev_info * rev,struct commit * commit,struct line_log_data * range)
methods.description: Processes blame ranges for a merge commit.

methods.name: int line_log_process_ranges_arbitrary_commit(struct rev_info * rev,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Main function to process blame ranges for any commit type.

methods.name: enum:rewrite_result line_log_rewrite_one(struct rev_info * rev UNUSED,struct commit ** pp)
methods.description: Rewrites blame data for a commit's history, following parent commits.

methods.name: int line_log_filter(struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Filters commits in rev to those with blame ranges.

methods.name: void free_void_line_log_data(void * data)
methods.description: Wrapper to free line_log_data in callback.

methods.name: void line_log_free(struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Frees all blame line log data in rev.
